convertibility_reason: Uses iCustom to load the 'Bezier' custom indicator and depends on TradeAlgorithms.mqh external library for all trade execution (open/close position functions). Custom indicator is not a built-in MT5 indicator.

derived_values.name: min_rates_total - minimum bars required before calculation
TimeShiftSec - chart period in seconds
derived_values.used_by: UpSignalTime and DnSignalTime calculation for trade signal timing

other_exits: Long closes when Bezier[1]>Bezier[2] (sell signal condition) and BuyPosClose input is true
Short closes when Bezier[1]<Bezier[2] (buy signal condition) and SellPosClose input is true

position_sizing.conditional_logic: Negative MM values are treated as fixed lot size (absolute value); positive MM values are treated as deposit fraction for risk-based sizing - logic handled by TradeAlgorithms.mqh

custom_logic_notes: Entry logic: Bezier indicator values from 3 consecutive bars (SignalBar, SignalBar+1, SignalBar+2) are compared. Buy when Bezier is rising (Value[1]<Value[2] and Value[0]>Value[1]) - indicating a Bezier curve turning upward. Sell when Bezier is falling (Value[1]>Value[2] and Value[0]<Value[1]) - indicating a Bezier curve turning downward. SignalBar=1 means signals are computed on the most recently closed bar (shift 1), not the forming bar. Separate boolean inputs (BuyPosOpen, SellPosOpen, BuyPosClose, SellPosClose) independently gate entry and exit permissions for long and short sides. The TradeAlgorithms.mqh library handles all position management including checking for existing positions before opening new ones.
python_conversion_notes: The Bezier custom indicator must be reimplemented in Python since it is not a standard MT5 indicator. The indicator parameters (period=8, T=0.5 sensitivity, applied_price=WEIGHTED) must be replicated exactly. The TradeAlgorithms.mqh library provides BuyPositionOpen, SellPositionOpen, BuyPositionClose, SellPositionClose functions which include position checking, lot sizing logic (negative=fixed lots, positive=deposit fraction), and SL/TP placement - all of this must be reimplemented. The position_gate is 'any' at the EA level but the TradeAlgorithms library likely checks for existing positions internally. SL/TP values (1000/2000 points) may need 5-digit adjustment (multiply by 10) depending on broker digit count - the EA does NOT do this adjustment itself so the Python version must handle it. Signal timing uses SeriesInfoInteger(SERIES_LASTBAR_DATE)+TimeShiftSec which approximates the next bar open time.
